output.message: I agree with Agents D2 and D7: Sell remains more defensible than Strong Sell. Monitor customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, operating cash flow, and funding runway. Reconsider if core demand stabilizes and AI partnerships generate measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation.
output.thought: The supplied information indicates weakening core software demand and declining client confidence, while unsustainable growth strategies and unusually high R&D spending raise profitability and cash-generation risks. Partnership and AI headlines do not establish commercial success. No verified financial statements, valuation, or liquidity figures are provided, limiting downside assessment.
